title: El pasado

lesson.title: El pasado simple: was/were, -ed y verbos irregulares
lesson.rule: Para 'was/were' (ser/estar en pasado): I/he/she was, you/we/they were. Los verbos regulares terminan en -ed: worked, visited. Los irregulares cambian: go→went, have→had, see→saw. Expresiones de tiempo: yesterday (ayer), last week (la semana pasada), last night (anoche).
examples: I was at the office at 9:00.
Last week I visited my family.
commonMistakes: I go yesterday → I went yesterday
I visited my family last week → NO 'the last week'

pronunciationTip: El pasado -ed suena distinto: worked /t/, played /d/, visited /id/. Practica: work-ed no se dice, es 'workt'.

phrases.en: I was at the office at 9:00.
phrases.es: Estaba en la oficina a las 9:00.

phrases.en: Last week I visited my family.
phrases.es: La semana pasada visité a mi familia.

phrases.en: Last night I watched a movie.

exercises.answer: Last week I visited my family.
